name: quote-builder
title: QuoteBuilder
summary: Composite for the quote flow. Lane input (origin + destination — composes Combobox) + weight input + accessorial chips + rate output (Stat) + book button. Right-rail layout: inputs left (60%), rate output + book right (40%). Mobile collapses to stacked layout.
description: Quote-flow composite — lane + weight + accessorials → rate + book.
skillDescription: Use as the centerpiece of a quoting surface — landing page CTA, in-product 'Get rate' modal, mobile bottom-sheet. Composes Combobox (lane) + NumberInput (weight) + Tag picker (accessorials) + Stat (rate output) + primary Button (book). Mobile collapses to single-column.
builtOn: Lumen primitives (Combobox + Input + Tag + Stat + Button)
anatomy: Left column: Lane (Combobox × 2) + Weight (NumberInput) + Accessorials (Tag picker)
Right column: Rate output (Stat hero) + Book button
never: NEVER allow Book without a rate.
NEVER use Title Case for the rate label.
a11yRules: Book button is the form's submit.
do: Use Stat hero for the rate display.
Disable Book until rate is fresh.
